text.title: Rust Ownership Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema for per-function ownership decision records.

section.title: Decision-record schema

example.note: answers.keeps_value must be boolean; param_kind must be in enum; crate_audit.audited must be true and rc_refcell_in_multi_thread must be false, with clone_count present; missing modifies_value, shares_across_threads, version, last_reviewed.

list.item: `Rc<T>` or `Rc<RefCell<T>>` captured across a thread or task boundary.
A `.clone()` present only to satisfy the borrow checker, with no stated justification.
Ownership handed onward by cloning instead of moving.
`'static` added to a signature purely to silence a lifetime error.
A crate_audit block with `audited: false` — an unrun audit is not a result.
